fields.name: APP_NAME
fields.label: Application name
fields.help: The name shown in your new application.

fields.name: OWNER_EMAIL
fields.label: Owner email
fields.help: The first owner signs in locally with one click; no email is sent.

fields.name: PROTECTED_DATA_KEY
fields.label: Protected supplier data key
fields.help: Installation-local encryption key. Keep a private recovery copy; losing it requires reentry of protected supplier values. Never include it in an archive.

fields.name: OIDC_PROVIDERS
fields.label: OIDC provider metadata (JSON)
fields.help: Optional public metadata array using auth, google, microsoft or okta presets. Include id and clientId, plus issuer or tenant where required. Never include credentials. Configure native owner admission at /auth/purse/identity after setup.

fields.name: SAML_PROVIDERS
fields.label: SAML provider configuration (private JSON)
fields.help: Optional array with id, label, issuer, entryPoint, entityId, idpCert and explicit subjectEmails associations. Only signed SP-initiated responses are accepted. Enable the provider as the current native owner in identity settings. Keep installation associations private.

fields.name: OIDC_CREDENTIALS
fields.label: OIDC provider credentials (private JSON)
fields.help: Required when OIDC_PROVIDERS contains a provider. Object keyed by provider id; each entry contains clientSecret or privateKey (private JWK with kid). Supply privately, never through command arguments or archives.

fields.name: OIDC_TRANSACTION_SECRET
fields.label: OIDC transaction secret
fields.help: Independent installation-local secret for OIDC browser transactions. Required when providers are configured; never reuse SESSION_SECRET or include it in an archive.

fields.name: PROTECTED_DATA_PREVIOUS_KEY
fields.label: Previous protected supplier data key
fields.help: Optional rotation secret. Keep the previous installation key here while the active key changes. Run owner rotation and verify its receipt before removing this secret. Supply privately; never use command arguments or archives.

fields.name: MAIL_PROVIDER
fields.label: Mail provider
fields.help: Choose a provider for hosted email. Local development suppresses mail and needs no provider account.
